name: Arkansas Championship 2025
information:
This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://southerncubing.com/) as the Arkansas State Championship for 2025!

While only residents of Arkansas are eligible for the title of Arkansas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Arkansas Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArkansasChampionship2025#52514-arkansas-champion-titles) tab.

All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArkansasChampionship2025#52516-important-information-faq) prior to registering.

This competition is part of the WCA Newcomer Month 2025. If you are new to competing, this would be a great competition to be your first!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--a01928cb85f93a25e3bf77443f5c08cd8e76c507/image.png)

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
